title: Fork-dLLM: Avoiding the Flexibility Trap in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) have shown strong potential for faster inference through parallel token generation when combined with confidence-based samplers. However, recent work has shown that such methods can defer unmasking high-entropy fork positions at which multiple plausible continuations exist. This results in reduced generation diversity, as shown by worse pass@k scaling, and limits gains obtainable from RL post-training. To avoid this flexibility trap, prior work advocated for autoregressive (AR) sampling. Here, we show that discarding confidence-based sampling is unnecessary and, once inference cost is taken into account, wasteful. We first propose Fork-dLLM, a simple hybrid sampler that uses AR-style ordering only at uncertain fallback steps while retaining parallel generation otherwise. translated_title: Fork-dLLM：避免扩散语言模型中的灵活性陷阱
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）与基于置信度的采样器结合时，通过并行token生成展现出强大的快速推理潜力。然而，最近的研究表明，这类方法可能会延迟解开存在多种合理延续的高熵“分叉”位置的掩码。这导致生成多样性下降（表现为pass@k扩展性能变差），并限制了强化学习后训练可获得的收益。为避免这种灵活性陷阱，先前的工作主张采用自回归（AR）采样。本文证明放弃基于置信度的采样是不必要的，而且一旦考虑推理成本，这种做法还是浪费的。我们首先提出Fork-dLLM，一个简单的混合采样器，它仅在不确定的回退步骤中使用AR风格的排序，而在其余情况下保留并行生成。然后我们将同一原理扩展到后训练阶段，提出ForkGRPO，它使用Fork-dLLM的rollout并应用GRPO目标函数。
tldr: 提出Fork-dLLM混合采样器和ForkGRPO后训练方法，仅在高不确定性的分叉步骤采用自回归式排序、其余情况保留并行生成，从而在不放弃置信度采样的前提下化解扩散语言模型的灵活性陷阱，兼顾推理效率、生成多样性与强化学习收益。
